verdict.rationale: incident.io requires an API key for its REST API and its hosted remote MCP server implements an OAuth-based bearer-token flow (401 + WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata), which implies some form of scoped/delegated authorization for agent access. However, there is no documentation of granular API key permission scopes, role-based key restrictions, or explicit least-privilege credential issuance tailored for AI agents. Missing for 10: documented API key scopes/permissions, explicit guidance on issuing narrowly-scoped credentials per agent, and confirmation that MCP OAuth tokens carry fine-grained least-privilege scopes rather than full account access.
